business.meta.title: TypeWhisper for business & teams
business.meta.description: Local-first speech-to-text for teams. Proprietary use, device management, and priority support.
business.hero.title: TypeWhisper for teams.
business.hero.subtitle: Local-first speech-to-text that never leaves the device. Proprietary use, device management, priority support, and auditable open-source code.
business.features.title: Built for teams that care about privacy and control.
business.features.subtitle: Everything you get as a team customer.
business.feature.deviceManagement.title: Device management
business.feature.deviceManagement.descri: License up to 10 (Team) or unlimited (Enterprise) devices under a single subscription.
business.feature.adminProfiles.title: App-aware profiles
business.feature.adminProfiles.descripti: Standardize language, engine, and behavior per app or domain across your team.
business.feature.customEngines.title: Custom engines & endpoints
business.feature.customEngines.descripti: Use your own Whisper endpoint, internal LLM, or approved cloud providers via the add-on system.
business.feature.compliance.title: Compliance-friendly
business.feature.compliance.description: On-device transcription. No voice data leaves the machine unless you opt into a cloud engine.
business.feature.prioritySupport.title: Priority support
business.feature.prioritySupport.descrip: Direct line to the team on hello@typewhisper.com for setup, rollout, and issue triage.
business.feature.auditable.title: Auditable source
business.feature.auditable.description: Full source is on GitHub under GPLv3. Security reviewers can audit what ships on your devices.
business.trust.title: Built to survive a security review.
business.trust.subtitle: Privacy is not a feature, it's the default. Everything runs on the device unless you explicitly opt into a cloud add-on.
business.trust.local.title: Local-first by default
business.trust.local.description: Audio never leaves the device when using on-device engines (WhisperKit, Parakeet, Apple SpeechAnalyzer).
business.trust.gpl.title: Open source under GPLv3
business.trust.gpl.description: Every line of code that ships is inspectable on GitHub.
business.trust.noTelemetry.title: No mandatory telemetry
business.trust.noTelemetry.description: No account wall, no required cloud check-in, no analytics we don't disclose.
business.trust.review.description: For firm IT, privacy reviewers, and partners, there is a dedicated checklist covering data flow, storage locations, optional cloud building blocks, and approval boundaries.
business.pricing.title: Pricing for teams.
business.pricing.subtitle: Team and Enterprise plans at a glance - full pricing and Lifetime options on the pricing page.
business.pricing.seeAll: See full pricing and Lifetime options
business.finalCta.title: Try free, upgrade when ready.
business.finalCta.subtitle: Download the macOS app, try it with your team, and pick a plan once you're sure.
